Hi John,

Thanks for the meeting. Here’s a quick summary of decisions and action items:

Decisions:
- Phase‑two rollout will start on 10 Feb 2026.
- Weekly status calls will now be on Tuesdays at 10:00.
- The reporting dashboard will use the revised metric definitions.

Action items:
- Dana will circulate the revised rollout timeline by 9 Jan 2026.
- Priya will confirm the dashboard metric definitions with the data team.
- All parties will prepare the phase‑two risk register before the next status call.

Please let us know if anything needs adjustment.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
